Yūko Miyamura (Japanese: 宮村優子 Miyamura Yūko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Miyamura was born on December 4, 1972, in , , . She graduated from the theater division for Toho Gakuen College of Drama and Music. She was diagnosed with Graves' disease and exophthalmos in May 2007. She was initially married to manga artist, Nakatani D. from 1998 to 1999. Miyamura married stuntman Takayuki Seki in 2004. They had two children together, a daughter born in 2004 and a son born in 2011, before they divorced in 2016. The family lived in , , until she returned to Japan after the divorce.
